title: Kengan Ashura
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Meek salaryman Kazuo Yamashita is assigned to look after Tokita 'Ashura' Ohma, a street fighter recruited by Nogi Group CEO Hideki Nogi for Kengan matches, unarmed bouts in which corporations settle business disputes through hired fighters, winner take all. Ohma enters the Kengan Annihilation Tournament for control of the Kengan Association as his hidden past resurfaces.
life_message: It holds up strength, grit and pushing one's limits, with loyalty between unlikely partners.

content.note: Brutal bare-knuckle bouts, flesh-cutting techniques, killings (Wikipedia; AniList Martial Arts 98%, Gore signal).
Ohma's dark past and life-or-death fights (AniList Tragedy signal; to verify).
Occasional fan service possible (MangaDex suggestive; to verify).
Adult drinking and smoking among executives (to verify).
